question:
**Choose the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

He has won the medal for the __twelth__ time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Twelfth**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the underlined word is **"Twelfth" (Option 3).**
 
• **Meaning in English: **"**Twelfth**" refers to the ordinal number **12th in a sequence.**
 
• **Meaning in Hindi: **"**Twelfth**" का हिंदी में अर्थ होता है १२वां, जो किसी क्रम में १२ वां स्थान को दर्शाता है।
